title: Reserve Airmen saves lives as part of Hurricane Harvey relief effort
description: Senior Airman Davy Brinkmann, 920th Rescue Wing HH-60 Pave Hawk helicopter special missions aviations specialist, hoists fellow pararescueman Staff Sgt. Gregg Forshaw hoisting a Hurricane Harvey victim onto a Pave Hawk Aug. 31, 2017 near Beaumont, Texas. The 920th RQW deployed roughly 90 Citizen Airmen, three Pave Hawks and two HC-130s to Texas in support of Air Force Northern's search and rescue mission for FEMA disaster relief effort. (U.S. Air Force video/Tech. Sgt. Lindsey Maurice)
